articles.title: Introducing gpt-oss
articles.description: We’re releasing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b—two state-of-the-art open-weight language models that deliver strong real-world performance at low cost. Available under the flexible Apache 2.0 license, these models outperform similarly sized open models on reasoning tasks, demonstrate strong tool use capabilities, and are optimized for efficient deployment on consumer hardware.
articles.raw_content: We’re releasing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b—two state-of-the-art open-weight language models that deliver strong real-world performance at low cost. Available under the flexible Apache 2.0 license, these models outperform similarly sized open models on reasoning tasks, demonstrate strong tool use capabilities, and are optimized for efficient deployment on consumer hardware.
articles.selection_reason: OpenAI releasing state-of-the-art open-weight models under Apache 2.0 is a landmark shift for researchers and early adopters building on frontier capabilities.
articles.audience_value: Direct access to gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b for fine-tuning, local deployment, and reasoning/tool-use experimentation without API lock-in.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators can now build, inspect, and adapt frontier-class reasoning models on their own hardware, unlocking research directions previously gated behind closed APIs.

articles.title: Introducing GPT-5.2
articles.description: GPT-5.2 is our most advanced frontier model for everyday professional work, with state-of-the-art reasoning, long-context understanding, coding, and vision. Use it in ChatGPT and the OpenAI API to power faster, more reliable agentic workflows.
articles.raw_content: GPT-5.2 is our most advanced frontier model for everyday professional work, with state-of-the-art reasoning, long-context understanding, coding, and vision. Use it in ChatGPT and the OpenAI API to power faster, more reliable agentic workflows.
articles.selection_reason: A new frontier model release with state-of-the-art reasoning, long-context, coding, and vision resets the capability baseline that all bleeding-edge work is measured against.
articles.audience_value: Understanding GPT-5.2's agentic workflow improvements helps pioneers re-evaluate what autonomous systems they can now realistically prototype.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators need to immediately benchmark their agentic prototypes against GPT-5.2's new reasoning and long-context ceiling to stay ahead of the curve.

articles.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner to address security incident during model evaluation
articles.description: OpenAI and Hugging Face share early findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, highlighting advanced cyber capabilities and lessons for defenders.
articles.raw_content: OpenAI and Hugging Face share early findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation, highlighting advanced cyber capabilities and lessons for defenders.
articles.selection_reason: A joint OpenAI–Hugging Face disclosure of a security incident revealing advanced AI cyber capabilities is a watershed moment for anyone evaluating frontier models.
articles.audience_value: Early findings on how model evaluation pipelines were compromised and what offensive capabilities emerged, informing safer research infrastructure design.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators running model evaluations on shared infrastructure must rethink their threat model now that frontier AI cyber capabilities have been demonstrated in the wild.

articles.title: AMD and OpenAI announce strategic partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs
articles.description: AMD and OpenAI have announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, beginning with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI innovation.
articles.raw_content: AMD and OpenAI have announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, beginning with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI innovation.
articles.selection_reason: A 6-gigawatt AMD GPU deal signals a major diversification of the AI compute stack away from Nvidia dominance, reshaping the hardware landscape for the next five years.
articles.audience_value: Insight into where next-generation training and inference capacity will come from and why ROCm/Instinct ecosystems may become critical for researchers.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators betting on hardware-agnostic tooling should track this shift, as AMD-scale compute could redefine cost curves for frontier experiments.
